title: DSH Superagent: Per-Ticket Execution Isolation & Serialized Channel Replies
summary: Each Ticket binds to an isolated Executor session and directory with scoped read visibility (excluding other Tickets and Decisions). Outbound channel replies are serialized per (Ticket, Conversation) so acknowledgements never overtake results.
